iterations.purpose: Move original mark onto pocket, remove old location and normalize backdrop
iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: preview-only revised apparel product mockup for artwork placement.
Input image1 is the EDIT TARGET and authoritative garment/artwork source. Input image2 is a BACKGROUND FAMILY REFERENCE ONLY. Do NOT copy image2's garment colour, missing pocket, artwork placement or any other product feature.
Primary edit: Move the existing small OFF SHFT mark from the middle of the chest onto the center of the existing chest pocket on the wearer's LEFT (VIEWER RIGHT). The entire exact OFF SHFT wordmark, its clock O, Rust hands and pivot must fit inside the pocket panel, below its opening seam and above its pointed bottom. Preserve its existing size if it fits, exact Unbounded letterforms, spacing, geometry, Ink letters/ring, Rust accent, and aspect ratio. Remove the former center-chest mark completely, restoring uninterrupted white fabric there. Exactly one mark remains, centered ON the pocket, not above the pocket, beside it, or underneath the fabric.
Keep the actual White Comfort Colors6030 pocket T-shirt shown in image1: full original front silhouette and cut, white colour (not ivory or cream), collar, sleeves, seams, hem, fine cotton grain, wrinkles and folds, original product scale and framing. Preserve the existing real chest pocket and all its perimeter/top stitching, opening and pointed lower edge. Decoration belongs only on the OUTER pocket panel; preserve an unobstructed usable pocket opening and never replace the pocket with a flat graphic rectangle or patch. No extra pocket, no logo on the main chest or sleeves, no neck branding, no additional text.
Secondary edit: replace the tan sunlight background with uniform opaque warm Bone #ECE5D3 seamless matte studio background matching image2's backdrop family. Retain only a short soft contact shadow directly beneath the shirt. Remove sunlight streaks, foliage shadows, long cast shadows and horizon. No white border, halo, props, hangers, overlay text or watermark.
Maintain the complete garment centered in the same square canvas, no cropping, no product reshaping or recolouring. The only product change is moving the original mark from its old location onto the center of the existing pocket and restoring blank fabric at the old location. This is a placement preview, not a production proof. Produce one opaque square image.
